name: Relentless Rage
summary: When a World Eaters unit makes a Charge move, until end of turn its melee weapons get +1 Attacks and +2 Strength.

name: Rampaging Terrors
summary: Friendly Daemon Vehicle units can, in the Fight phase, force one engaged enemy unit to take a Battle-shock test at -1, once per unit per phase. Cannot combine with another Onslaught-tagged detachment.

name: Adamantine Avalanche
summary: When a friendly Terminator Squad unit is engaged in the Fight phase, roll for and activate one Blessing of Khorne for Terminator Squad units this phase, stacking with any other currently active Blessing.

name: Idols of Khorne
summary: Each Command phase, pick one Idol of Khorne aura for World Eaters Titanic/Monster units until your next Command phase: +1 Hit/Wound, +1 Move and Advance/Charge, or 4+ invulnerable save to nearby Jakhals/Goremongers (also Battleline).

name: Rush to the Fray
summary: When a World Eaters unit disembarks from a Transport, until end of turn it gets +1 to Charge rolls and its melee weapons gain Lance.

name: Blood Tithe
summary: Destroying an enemy unit with a Blood Legions/World Eaters unit earns a Blood Tithe point on a 3+. Spend points each Command phase for a buff (Feel No Pain, Lance, invuln, Blessings of Khorne); unlocks a capped Blood Legions contingent.

name: Brazen Fury
summary: World Eaters Possessed units that lose a model to enemy shooting can make a D6 inch surge move in the opponent's Shooting phase.

name: Wrath of Khorne
summary: When a World Eaters Character unit (non-Epic Hero) fights, its Character models' melee attacks gain Cleave 1 or +1 AP (your choice).
